nodes.text: Operator, can you hear me? I need to get through the gate. I am going home.

answers.text: Ask where he is coming from
answers.reply: The village up the road. I have been walking since morning.
Thank you, operator. I will keep moving.
All this way for nothing? Fine. I am leaving.
